name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration and royalty company focused on acquiring and advancing mineral properties in Nevada, consistently rated one of the world's best mining jurisdictions. The company holds a strategic land package and royalty interests across multiple projects including Lapon Canyon, Agai-Pah, and Loman in Nevada and Idaho. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage, running active drill programs while building royalty income streams from its property portfolio.
